Plot the trajectories that fed into a target in 3D (confluence)

Source: R/plot_trajectory_formation_3d.R
plot_trajectory_formation_3d.Rd

Interactive 3D (plotly) version of plot_trajectory_formation_2d(), in the idiom of plot_group_trajectories_lines_3d(). The target trajectory is a cumulative "river" line at lane y = 0 whose height (z) grows with the papers absorbed. Each feeder sits on its own lane and rises along a measured curve (see feeder_curve); a connector then drops from the feeder's end onto the river at its handoff year, its width scaled by the papers n that actually transferred. So the slope shows how each feeder built up and the connector shows how much of it flowed into the target.

Usage

plot_trajectory_formation_3d(
  formation,
  feeder_curve = c("size", "inflow"),
  max_feeders = 8,
  log_scale = TRUE,
  width_range = c(3, 12),
  title = NULL,
  label_size = 16,
  hover_font_size = 12,
  descriptions = NULL
)

Arguments

formation

Output of sniff_trajectory_formation() (or one element of sniff_trajectory_formations()).

feeder_curve

What the feeder slope traces: "size" (default) is the feeder's measured cluster size per year, ending at cohort_size (can rise and fall as the community merges and splits; best read with log_scale = TRUE); "inflow" is the cumulative arrival of just the n contributed papers, a monotone curve ending at n on the river's scale.

max_feeders

Maximum number of feeders to draw, by descending papers (default: 8). Papers in omitted feeders are noted in the title.

log_scale

Apply log1p() to the z-axis (papers), which keeps large feeders from dwarfing the river (default: TRUE).

width_range

Line-width range, scaled by papers (default: c(3, 12)).

title

Plot title (default: the target trajectory key).

label_size

Font size for the end labels (default: 16).

hover_font_size

Font size for hover tooltips (default: 12).

descriptions

Optional data frame of manual hover descriptions (default: NULL). Must have columns id (trajectory key "group::traj_id" or "group:traj_id") and text. When supplied, the matching target or feeder node shows the description on hover; others keep the default hover.

Value

A plotly 3D plot object.

See also

plot_trajectory_formation_2d(), sniff_trajectory_formation(), plot_group_trajectories_lines_3d()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
f <- sniff_trajectory_formation(
  "c1g10::tr1", groups_detected_trajectories,
  groups_cumulative_trajectories$docs_per_group
)
plot_trajectory_formation_3d(f)
} # }
